extraction_notes: Catalytic-performance data are mainly in Figure 1 and Table 5. Table 5 gives exact methanol productivity and methanol selectivity at 250 °C for Pd10Zn1 and Pd1Zn1–Pd1Zn20; the pure Pd/TiO2 250 °C productivity and all 230/270 °C productivities were read approximately from Figure 1 right. CO2 conversion and CO/CH4 selectivities at 250 °C were read approximately from Figure 1 left. The paper states catalytic testing conditions once: 230, 250, and 270 °C; 20 bar; 20 % CO2, 60 % H2, 5 % Ar, 15 % N2 after reduction in 5 % H2/N2 at 400 °C for 1 h. No GHSV, catalyst mass, total flow, or time-on-stream for the catalytic testing were reported in the provided main text.
